title: A Restaurant Review
text:
Mia wrote a review of a new restaurant that serves Italian food. She said the pizza was very good and the staff were friendly. The restaurant is near the train station.

However, Mia said the waiting time was long. She waited forty minutes for a table. She gave the restaurant four stars out of five.

questions.text: How many stars did Mia give the restaurant?
Why did Mia give four stars and not five?
What does Mia probably think of the restaurant?
options: She will never go there again
She does not like the food
She is angry with the staff

vocabulary.definition: a written opinion about a product, place or service
a flat round bread with cheese and toppings
spending time until something happens or someone is ready
the people who work in a place

paragraph_translations: Mia yeni bir İtalyan yemeği sunan restoran hakkında bir değerlendirme yazdı. Pizzanın çok lezzetli olduğunu ve personelin güler yüzlü olduğunu söyledi. Restoran tren istasyonunun yakınında.
Ama Mia bekleme süresinin uzun olduğunu söyledi. Masa için kırk dakika bekledi. Restorana beş üzerinden dört yıldız verdi.
